*FREE GUIDE: 📘 The Content Creator's AI Blueprint*  – https://FirstMovers.ai/blueprint/

In 1930, Keynes predicted we'd only work 15 hours a week by 2030. Productivity exploded, the hours never came back, and an *AI clone* is how I finally took mine.

What you'll learn:
✅ Why the word *robot* comes from the Czech word for forced labor
✅ How the factory clock turned your *identity* into a job title
✅ 5 things to try this week to take your time back

Wait until you hear what Claude invented when I gave it *no direction*.

#AI #FutureOfWork #Burnout
